scripts.build: bun run check:logic && tsc --noEmit && bun run scripts/build.mjs
scripts.mobile:prepare: bun run build && bun run scripts/prepare-mobile.mjs
scripts.mobile:add:android: bun run mobile:prepare && npx cap add android
scripts.mobile:add:ios: bun run mobile:prepare && npx cap add ios
scripts.mobile:sync: bun run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync
